# A package removed from "packages" is gone from the hub after the next muxt
# generate, so a template that still links to it fails muxt check.

muxt generate
muxt check

cp muxt.json.new muxt.json
muxt generate
! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
  "route_paths": {},
  "package_defaults": {
    "use_receiver_type": "Server"
  },
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m/admin": [
      {}
    ],
    "example.com/m/blog": [
      {}
    ]
  }
}
-- muxt.json.new --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">x</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
